change: Adapt Sloppy f9ba5a4 recursive return sinking for release builds: return same-type moved branch values directly instead of keeping them live across sibling calls. Loop back-edges, conversions, cleanup and effects remain barriers.

validation.fuzz: Seeds 401..600 pass in five modes, half using the independent bootstrap (1,000 executions).
validation.test_cleanup: Remove a duplicate definition of the narrow-slot test; pytest had collected the identical final definition. Coverage is unchanged.

performance: Integer fib(38) is about 4.2% faster on the laptop, with a smaller stack frame and one fewer saved register; floating recursion is flat. Desktop integer timing is inconclusive. Release compilation adds about 0.13% instructions on throughput and 0.29% on the fixed compiler; all 12 laptop compilation comparisons pass. Existing 28 runtime artifacts remain unchanged. These are bounded recursion results, not general C parity.
baseline: No whole-stage baseline promotion. Fixed ea1cba0e and accepted cd07ea34 unchanged.
